
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- analog_on_gpio_pin.volt:2[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp8266` to volt.toml: chip = "esp8266"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] 
 [dim]2 |[/dim] chip esp8266
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[red bold]-- HARDWARE ERROR -- analog_on_gpio_pin.volt:4[/red bold]

GPIO 4 is not an analog pin. ESP8266 has only one ADC input (A0/TOUT) which is not a GPIO.

 [dim]3 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]4 |[/dim]     pin sensor: Analog = 4
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]        ^^^^^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Use the dedicated A0 pin for analog reads.[/cyan]
